coverage.name: Summit County
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-12: the county clerk's 2026 General Election page (ballots mailed 'the week of October 5, 2026') still posts no sample ballot, ballot-content certification or participating-entities list. Its Ballot Information section still says: 'If you would like an electronic version of the Summit County TABOR notice ("White Book") please email' the elections office. Participation therefore cannot be confirmed.

The only county referral found is still BOCC Resolution 2026-57, Summit County Referred Measure 1A. It extends the existing 4.652-mill Strong Future property tax indefinitely for wildfire prevention, mental health/substance abuse/suicide prevention, early childhood care, public buildings/community facilities, and recycling/waste diversion. Excluded: the question text does not earmark housing. (A recital mentions reducing 'homelessness' as a result of mental-health programs, but the submission clause does not fund housing or homelessness.) Exhibit A submission clause: 'Without raising any additional taxes and to continue funding for: Wildfire prevention; Mental health, substance abuse services, and suicide prevention programs for Summit County youth and adults; Affordable early childhood care and learning for Summit County families and workers; Improving public buildings/community facilities and extending their useful life; and Sustaining recycling and waste diversion programs, shall Summit County be authorized to continue to collect and expend revenues previously approved by Summit County voters in 2018 by Summit County Referred Measure 1A by the ongoing extension of the existing four and six hundred fifty-two thousandths mill levy property tax commencing January 1, 2028, and continuing thereafter as a voter-approved revenue change, without limitation or condition under Article X, Section 20 of the Colorado Constitution or any other law, with all expenditures made in consideration of independent citizen advisory committee recommendations and subject to annual independent financial audit?'

Rechecked 2026-10-10: the 2026 resolutions index now runs to 2026-70, but its numbering gaps remain (2026-56 and 2026-58 to 2026-63 are not posted), so another county referral cannot be ruled out until the sample ballot or TABOR notice is posted.

News in 2025 reported a possible November 2026 regional transportation authority question. Later reporting (Oct 2025) said the county paused RTA planning. No official referral was found. It would be transit, not housing, unless its text earmarks housing.

The Diligent BOCC agenda portal (summitcountyco.community.diligentoneplatform.com) was reached on 2026-09-26, but its agenda packets could not be opened as documents. Agendas were not reviewed item by item.

Rechecked 2026-10-12: the county resolutions index is unchanged (it ends at 2026-70, and 2026-56 and 2026-58 to 2026-63 are still not posted). 2026-57 (Strong Future 1A) is still the only ballot referral listed.
